test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The murder of a large number of people from a particular nation or ethnic group.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Genocide.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term **"genocide"** refers to the intentional action to destroy a people—usually defined as an ethnic, national, racial, or religious group—in whole or in part. (जन-संहार)
